Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Suresh - 28 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Hema - 60 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Nitin - 66 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Ajay - 34 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The airport - check-in counters, big windows
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The airport - Day

[Suresh stands at the airport. Hema and Ajay stand near him.]

Hema: "What lovely weather!"

[Suresh drags his suitcase to the gate.]

Ajay: "Aunty, look at this."

[Suresh hugs Mother goodbye at the airport.]

Suresh: "What happened?"

[Suresh waves goodbye as he goes through security.]

Suresh: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

Suresh: "Let's begin."

[Suresh rides his motorbike to the market.]

Nitin: "Oh wow!"

[Suresh takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Nitin: "Careful!"

[Suresh's nose is bleeding after the punch.]

Suresh: "I'm ready!"

[Suresh withdraws cash from the ATM.]

Suresh (laughing): "Well done!"

[Suresh wades through the knee-deep water.]

Hema (happily): "That was such a fun day!"
